main_text.p: mo supra quingētos triginta quatuor Lutetię Parisiorū. Vnde quoque programatū& Inscriptorum annus in Gallia est prouerbiali quasi genere dicēdi nominatus. Eorū autem qui tum cæterorum omnium amplissimè fideliss.q.vitam vouissent, aliquando tandem inuentā plānè,& in lucem hic nunc primum(vt quidē voluimus) edita historiā damus.

NNI 1534. tempus cum ad varios rerum & ancipites euentus plerisque in locis,tum Lutetiæ maximè insigne & fatale fuit. Nam cum Gerardus Ruffus Margaritæ Francisci Galliæ Regis sororis, Reginæ Nauarræ auspicio,& Couraldus,& Berthaudus, alii que clariss. viri quidam itademum Euangelij veritatem enuntiarent, vt tum primum illuxisse Lutetiæ verbum Domini videretur; Euangelij perduelles Sorbonistæ quum horum hominum splendorem in dicendo,& concurrentis illò populi celebritate & frequentiā animad uerterent, expugnauerunt vt illis suggestus interdiceretur,grauis simo dolore eorum qui ex huiusmodi concionibus plurimūm se conse cutos esse arbitrabantur.Illi tanta iniuria Reipub. commoti Christi anæ,concionem in priuatam & domesticam docendi rationem æquali fere successu professúque conuerterunt. quod ipsum quoque per tæsi hostes iurati veritatis,rursum obtinuerunt,vt de concionibus in terdistū etiam ad domesticam Euangelij profitendi & in præccepta di gerendi confuetudinem indista graui multa pertinere putaretur. Quo nomine Gerardus ipse comprehensus, Couraldus in custodiam pontificiam traditus fuit.Porro fideles destituti concionibus, desecti doctoribus,in lustu & squalore versabantur.Vnde impetu quodam animi præcipiti commoti magis quàm vsi cogitatione nōnulli,operæ pretium cēsuerunt esse,rem ad Allobroges deferre;idque sequi potis simum, quod optimum interea factu putarent. Itaque Feretum quen dam famulum tum pharmacopolæ Francisci Regis, ad eam expediti onem deligunt,delestum expediunt:qui Neocomum profestus sub id fere tempus cum Gulielmus Farellus Euangelium populariter auspi cato Geneuæ profiteri cœpisset, programata quædam in Missæ deli ria,& rituum huiusmodi papisticorum ludibria charasterib° excudi curauit.Quibus inscriptionibus Lutetiam deportatis,dedustisque in deliberationem proferrine eas,an omnino comprini oporteret, Cou raldus ipse quidem minimè proferri censebat oportere. hinc enim & motum maximum populi fore;& huius totius facinoris inuidiam in odium atque caput fidelium hominum redundaturam esse. page.notes: The text of the first paragraph and the running head are as printed. Doubtful readings: "NNI 1534" is the opening word, the N with decorated initial; likely "Nnii" (Anno 1534 with the ligature) and read as "Nni 1534" with [?] applied: Nni 1534 [?]. "subid" rendered as "sub id", "Euangelij" printed as such. The word "squalore" and "charasterib°" are as printed. The top line "Programmata." may be a catchword-like fragment, but it is part of the running head. Catchword "mum" is the final word at the foot, right-aligned, and it is also left in the paragraph text as printed (half-word line-end, "ad extre-mum"). Note: the catchword rule says the catchword must not also appear in the main text, so the trailing "mum" should be removed from the paragraph. Printed text retained as seen; transcription is best effort given scan resolution.
